summary: All tests pass. The needle was an auth bypass in `middleware.go`: it checked the raw `r.URL.Path` for the `/api/` prefix, while the router matched against `path.Clean(r.URL.Path)`. Requests like `//api/admin` or `/health/../api/data` skipped the auth check but still resolved to protected handlers. Fixed by having the middleware clean the path the same way the router does before checking the prefix.
